for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(py_root):
    for fn in filenames:
        if fn.endswith(".py"):
            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dirpath, fn), ROOT)
            py_sync_plugins.append(rel)
py_sync_plugins.sort()

py_async_plugins = []
py_root2 = os.path.join(ROOT, "py/aiomavsdk/aiomavsdk/plugins")
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(py_root2):
    for fn in filenames:
        if fn.endswith(".py"):
            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dirpath, fn), ROOT)
            py_async_plugins.append(rel)
py_async_plugins.sort()

# ---- apply fixes to units ----
units_by_name = {u["name"]: u for u in m["units"]}

def replace_glob(unit_name, glob_suffix, literal_list):
    u = units_by_name[unit_name]
    u["files"] = [f for f in u["files"] if not f.endswith(glob_suffix)]
    u["files"].extend(literal_list)

# mavlink-transport-core: add missing serial_connection.hpp
core = units_by_name["mavlink-transport-core"]
if "cpp/src/mavsdk/core/serial_connection.hpp" not in core["files"]:
    core["files"].append("cpp/src/mavsdk/core/serial_connection.hpp")

# jni-bindings
jni_u = units_by_name["jni-bindings"]
jni_u["files"] = [f for f in jni_u["files"] if f not in ("jni/plugins/**", "jni/jvm/src/main/java/**")]
jni_u["files"].extend(jni_plugins)
jni_u["files"].extend(jni_jvm)

# grpc-server-daemon
grpc_u = units_by_name["grpc-server-daemon"]
grpc_u["files"] = [f for f in grpc_u["files"] if f not in (
    "cpp/src/mavsdk_server/src/plugins/**  (39 subdirs, one <plugin>_service_impl.hpp each, e.g. action/action_service_impl.hpp, telemetry/telemetry_service_impl.hpp, camera/camera_service_impl.hpp, ftp/ftp_service_impl.hpp, param/param_service_impl.hpp, camera_server/camera_server_service_impl.hpp, action_server/action_server_service_impl.hpp, tracking_server/tracking_server_service_impl.hpp, etc.)",
    "cpp/src/mavsdk_server/src/generated/**  (~229 checked-in protoc/grpc-generated .pb.h/.pb.cc/.grpc.pb.h/.grpc.pb.cc files, one set per plugin group plus mavsdk_options.*; too many to enumerate individually, listed as a directory glob)"
)]
grpc_u["files"].extend(mavsdk_server_plugins)
grpc_u["files"].extend(mavsdk_server_generated)
# fix entrypoint location for gRPC network API to a literal listed file
for ep in grpc_u["entrypoints"]:
    if ep["name"] == "gRPC network API":
        ep["location"] = "cpp/src/mavsdk_server/src/generated/core/core.grpc.pb.h"

# kotlin-bindings
kt_u = units_by_name["kotlin-bindings"]
kt_u["files"] = [f for f in kt_u["files"] if "**" not in f]
kt_u["files"].extend(kotlin_files)

# python-sync-bindings
psync_u = units_by_name["python-sync-bindings"]
psync_u["files"] = [f for f in psync_u["files"] if "**" not in f]
psync_u["files"].extend(py_sync_plugins)
psync_u["effects"].append({"kind": "filesystem", "description": "cmavsdk_loader.py searches known filesystem paths (package-relative mavsdk/lib/, and cwd/lib/) to locate the native shared library before loading it."})

# python-async-bindings
pasync_u = units_by_name["python-async-bindings"]
pasync_u["files"] = [f for f in pasync_u["files"] if "**" not in f and f != "py/aiomavsdk/setup.py"]
pasync_u["files"].extend(py_async_plugins)

print("jni_plugins:", len(jni_plugins))
print("jni_jvm:", len(jni_jvm))
print("mavsdk_server_plugins:", len(mavsdk_server_plugins))
print("mavsdk_server_generated:", len(mavsdk_server_generated))
print("kotlin_files:", len(kotlin_files))
print("py_sync_plugins:", len(py_sync_plugins))
print("py_async_plugins:", len(py_async_plugins))

with open(MANIFEST, "w") as f:
    json.dump(m, f, indent=2)

print("wrote", MANIFEST)
